text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and everyone's
hearts are
aflutter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just like good friends, it's common for

Umamusume and their trainers to
exchange gifts
as a symbol of their
bond... under normal
circumstances,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп doesn't do normal. It would
be best not
to expect business as usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still, I've brought some chocolate for
her, just to
be on the safe side.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Giving it to her after training should be
enough to
make this feel like Valentine's
Day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Or at least, that's what I thought...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not only does Голд Шипп not show up for
training,
she's still nowhere to be seen
by the time sunset
rolls around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I hope she hasn't gotten into trouble...

text_block_list.text:
Getting worried, I pull out my phone to
call her,
when suddenly...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... bzzzt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Peace, peace! ☆ Golshi here! ☆ I haven't
seen you
all day. You alive?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: I should be asking you that!

text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You don't beat around the bush,
do you?
Sorry, I had a little something
to take care of.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I'm out on the water right now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The high seas, matey! Where else would
you find
a Ship?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But whew! Catching a decent-sized red
sea bream
sure took a while.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Beep, beЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Talk about out of the blue... It looks like
all I can
do is wait.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Look at you! If you had a tail, I bet you'd
be
wagging it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Sorry if I worried ya. But I hope you'll
agree... that
this is worth the wait!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Thud!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here we go! One red sea bream,
fresh-caught and
ready to eat!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Today's Valentine's, right? Here's
a little
something to show my
appreciation. Thanks,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Flop, flop!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Of all the things you could question
here, you
pick that?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The thing just wouldn't die, so I didn't
bother
gutting it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I figure I've done my part by this point,
so I'll
leave the rest to you! Slice it up
nice and neat,
wouldja?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We end up taking the fish to the
cafeteria and
letting a professional
prepare it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But good golly did I catch a big-un. Now
hurry'n
get yer butt over here.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting by the shore. Later.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Beep, beЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've got no idea what's going on, but it
sounds
like I'd better head for the
beach!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, over here! What kept you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: What are you doing out here?

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Today's Valentine's Day. Haven't
you
heard?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: And you know what that means... Voila!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
She pushes something into my hands so
suddenly
that I almost drop it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here, for you! It's sea bream sashimi.
Fresh,
tender, and delicious!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Nothing makes sense anymore. For lack
of
anything better to do, I look up at the
sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm stuffed! That was some
mighty good
sea bream.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
This Valentine's Day was anything but
normal...
but I did get to eat some great
sashimi.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I want to thank Голд Шипп for going out
of her
way to catch and prepare it for
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What, you got me something, too? A
real sucker
for protocol, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Well, it looks like we both got each
other gifts.
Heh, I knew I was right to go
with the sea bream.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Gonna ask straight up? Want a
peek at
Golshi's heart, do you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You know how flowers have symbols and

meanings and yadda yadda yadda?
Well, so do
fish.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: And red sea bream means...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Actually, y'know what? I'm not gonna
tell you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Maruzen once told me that a lady always
knows
what cards to keep to her chest.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So if you wanna know, you're just gonna
have to
find out yourself! Later!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day with Голд Шипп sure was
a
rollercoaster ride, but I had fun... I
think.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It makes for delicious sashimi.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
